summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate of Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands on software development experience identifying and fixing performance bottlenecks across the full hardware and software stack. Rewrote CUDA kernels for GPU inference and benchmarked distributed MPI workloads, backing every result with performance validation and clear technical documentation. Comfortable communicating results across C/C++, Python, and Linux based engineering environments end to end.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed wearable gesture-recognition glove firmware integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth microcontrollers to translate hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented an interrupt-driven tap-detection algorithm with z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through structured debugging of the hardware-software interface.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Owned mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and hardware bring-up end-to-end for a 25-member national-competition robotics team.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript convolution layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory, identifying and closing a hardware performance bottleneck in the inference pipeline.
Validated a 35 percent speedup over the naive GPU baseline (49.2ms vs 73.3ms) and 1.5 to 2 times speedup over CPU TorchScript, with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work distribution strategies (static strip, block, cyclic, and dynamic task queue) for rendering 5000 by 5000 pixel scenes across a distributed system.
Validated up to a 30 times speedup with static strip partitioning across 55 processes; documented that the dynamic task queue outperformed all static methods under unpredictable workloads.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through structured debugging across the full hardware and software stack; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Integrated a TensorRT-optimized YOLO model for visual servoing, achieving a 5.2 times inference speedup over eager PyTorch (56.7 to 10.9 milliseconds).
Deployed the Jetson-side firmware bridge as a supervised systemd service with auto-restart, non-root isolation, and static IP networking in a Linux-based engineering environment.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 microcontroller firmware in bare-metal embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and interrupt-driven ADC1 sample capture.
Programmed peripherals directly (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1), achieving a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified functional correctness in Proteus lab simulation.
